# PAAS-001: Self hosted platform detected

- **Group:** Coolify and Dokploy
- **Severity when it fails:** info
- **Root:** not needed

## Why it matters

Coolify and Dokploy change what a safe host looks like: they publish a reverse proxy and a panel, write app .env files on every deploy and keep the SSH keys of every server they manage. Knowing the platform and its role (panel or managed server) tells the other checks what to expect. Without Docker facts the role and version come from the disk only and may stay unknown.

## Verify by hand

```sh
ls -ld /data/coolify /etc/dokploy; docker ps --format '{{.Names}} {{.Image}}'
```

## How to fix it

Nothing to fix; this records the platform for the other checks.
